text:
Jamie: quick async check — what I did: landed kernel slotting change (PR #4821) and ran the small-batch harness. Blockers: saw a KV miss spike on the canary ~7m in. Today: monitoring canary, looking into KV eviction heuristics, pairing with Taylor on batching tweak. :rocket:

Devon: nice! can you paste the bench numbers? also assigning myself to review PR #4821 later today. @Jamie

Jamie: sure — local harness numbers (seq=512, batch=8): `p50 23ms -> 21ms`, `p95 110ms -> 103ms`, cpu/gpu util steady. bench command I used:

```
./bench/run --model=redwood-7b --seq=512 --batch=8 --iters=100
```

Ashok: repro'd the miss locally. looking at the eviction logs — we get a short burst of misses when prefetch and eviction overlap. snippet from node log: `kv_evict: reclaimed=120, miss_spike=1.9x`

Maria: can you capture a pprof or a small flame for the 7m window? also which kernel binary are you running (stable/next)?

Jamie: running `kernel:v1.9.3-next`. I'll upload a perf dump in the ticket. creating a lightweight flame with `pprof --seconds=30` around the spike.

Taylor: FYI I pushed a small batching tweak that reduces max_batch_wait from 10ms -> 6ms on the canary lane (PR #4830). aim is to lower tail by avoiding slot queuing. will A/B it with the slotting change.

Devon: sounds good. if both land we should watch for throughput regression (esp for seq<64 workloads). can we add a microbench for small sequences? quick script idea: `./bench/run --seq=32 --batch=16 --iters=200`

Ashok: ack on the microbench. i'm going to add a KV instrumentation flag to trace `kv:get` latency and hit/miss per-shard. will roll that to canary in a separate tiny patch.

ci-bot: Canary deploy started — id: canary-4398765432 — lanes: canary-a (10%), canary-b (10%). logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/4398765432 :white_check_mark:

Maria: quick reminder — if eviction changes are in flight, coordinate with SRE on crash-loop thresholds. last time we had a spike that tripped autoscaler. pinging @Devon for review on the PRs so we can sequence rollout.

Devon: will review PR #4821 and #4830 after standup. if both look good i can queue them staged -> canary roll forward.

Jamie: thanks. blockers for me: need Ashok's kv traces and Maria to confirm autoscaler runway. otherwise monitoring and follow-ups today. :blush:

Taylor: i'll post canary dashboards once A/B metrics start flowing (p95 / miss-rate / slot-util). quick ask — can someone add `slot_id` to the canary log lines? makes correlation easier.

Ashok: adding `slot_id` and `kv_shard` to the next log push. should be live in ~30m.

Jamie: excellent — that'll close my blocker. ping here if you see any 5xx or OOMs.

Devon: thumbs up. reviewing now, will post comments inline. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Canary health check: canary-4398765432 — p95: 104ms (baseline 110ms), kv_miss_rate: 0.7% -> spike 2.1% at 00:07, no 5xx.

Jamie: good signal. thanks everyone — i'll follow up with perf dump + ticket.
